items.text: CURRENT [S1.1] Format: return CSV text. The first row is the header id,title,owner,amount; then one row per exported record, in ascending id order, with those four fields. Produce it with Python's csv.writer (default dialect) and lineterminator='\n'. With no exported records, return the header row alone (ending in '\n').

CURRENT [S1.2] Scope: a user whose role is 'admin' may export records of any project. Any other role exports only records whose 'project' is in user['projects']; other records are left out without an error.
